svg.title: One month, one sealed statement
svg.desc: Availability 99.7021% falls in the 99.5–99.9% tier, so the credit is 5% of $300,000 = $15,000. Counted downtime: gpu-016 26 h, gpu-014 4 h, gpu-003 2.47 h, gpu-011 2 h, gpu-005 1 h. Excluded: gpu-010 3 h (announced firmware update), gpu-012 1.5 h (customer-caused).

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
